description: Updated to the European Commission decision of 2023-11-23 (II/0135, KEYNOTE-859), which removed HER-2 negative gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma from this indication and included it in the gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma indication (ind:ema:keytruda:14). The earlier version, approved on 2021-06-24 (II/0097), is ind:ema:keytruda:16.
